overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the 'Insurance Discussion' topic and the unlisted Mikuszewski policy item were not shown to be reasonably anticipated 48 hours out. It flagged notice and minutes concerns as recommendations only.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the June 8, 2022 notice topic 'Insurance Discussion' was not specific enough to inform the public of the insurance matters discussed.
allegations.key_passage: Yet, without clarification, a reasonable person would not have necessarily understood that a general discussion of the Committee’s insurance policies was intended under the topic “Insurance Discussion.”

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee took up the Mikuszewski family health insurance reinstatement, which was not on the notice, and granted extensive benefits at district expense.
The AG itself raised concern that the June 8, 2022 minutes did not summarize the insurance discussion, including the Mikuszewski policy; no complaint allegation on minutes is stated.
allegations.key_passage: Meeting minutes must include a summary of the discussion on each topic.

remedy: Recommended, not ordered: in the future, provide additional clarification concerning the discussion topics on meeting notices.
Recommended, not ordered: amend the June 8 meeting minutes to include a summary of the discussion of the various insurance policies.
remedy_passage: We recommend that the Committee amend the June 8 meeting minutes to include a summary of the discussion of the various insurance policies.
